name: OmokageFaceTracking
summary:
# Bring every expression to life

Omokage is a face-tracking companion app built for VRChat. It connects compatible USB face-tracking hardware to the Omokage Windows app over your local network, so your avatar can mirror your expressions in real time.

No camera or computer? Open Expression Studio on your headset. Use sliders to animate a virtual character, save your favorite expressions as presets, and record and replay animations up to 10 seconds long.

## High performance, low overhead

Efficient capture
